description: CsNaMg₆O₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4mm space group. Cs is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are four shorter (2.47 Å) and one longer (2.62 Å) Cs-O bond length. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. There is one shorter (2.11 Å) and four longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.37 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.37 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.37 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.37 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Cs, one Na, and four equivalent Mg atoms to form OCsNaMg₄ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OCsNaMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. In the second O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with eight ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve OCsNaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with ten OCsNaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Cs and four Mg atoms to form OCs₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with ten OCsNaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-33°.
